*Navigation*: 

_Homepage / Submissions / New Submission → on Account Selection (re-runs on Product change)_

*Story* 

|*As an*|Underwriter or BD User|
|*I want to*|have the system automatically suggest the correct submission type (New Business, Cross-Sell, or Renewal) when I select an account — and re-evaluate if I change the selected products|
|*So that*|I spend less time on manual classification, reduce miscategorization errors, and ensure downstream workflows (legal notice eligibility, renewal automation, cross-sell flags) trigger correctly from the start|

*Context / Gap Note*

 In UWB-1 (NB-01: Create New Submission for New Business and Cross Sell), the Submission Type field is a mandatory radio button (New Business / Cross-sell) that the user selects manually. Renewal is not covered in UWB-1. No system logic currently exists to auto-determine or suggest the correct type. This story adds that detection layer on top of the existing field — the field remains user-editable at all times.

*Detection Logic*

 

|*Scenario*|*System Determination*|*Confidence*|*Notes*|
|Account has no prior policy in PCAS and no prior submission history|→ New Business|High|Default for net-new accounts|
|Account has an active policy for at least one product AND selected product(s) are NOT on the active policy|→ Cross-Sell|High|At least one existing active policy must exist on the account for any product|
|Account has an active policy expiring within the renewal window (default: 90–180 days, configurable) AND selected product(s) match the expiring policy|→ Renewal|High|Exact product code match required between selected products and PCAS active policy|
|Some selected products match expiring policy; others do not|→ Renewal (for matching products); prompt user to add separate Cross-Sell for new products|High|Mixed-scenario banner is shown; see UI Behavior below|
|Account has a lapsed policy (expired within 12 months, not renewed) and same product re-submitted|→ New Business (with lapse flag)|Medium|Banner shown: 'Prior policy lapsed on [date]. Proceeding as New Business.'|
|Account exists in Salesforce but no PCAS policy record found|→ Default to New Business; user editable|Medium|Banner shown: 'No active policy found in PCAS. Defaulted to New Business — please verify.'|
|PCAS unavailable at time of detection|→ Field left blank; manual entry required|N/A|Banner: 'Policy lookup unavailable – please verify submission type manually.' Does not block creation.|

 

*Fields & Behavior*

 

|*Field*|*Section*|*Type*|*Behavior*|*Validation*|
|Submission Type|Submission Type|Radio Button (pre-selected)|Auto-populated on account selection with system-suggested type. Re-evaluated when products are changed. Field remains user-editable at all times.|Mandatory (existing rule from UWB-1 unchanged)|
|Auto-detected Badge|Submission Type|Inline chip / badge|Displays 'Auto-detected' next to the selected type when the system has populated it. Changes to 'Manually set' if the user overrides the suggestion.|—|
|Detection Tooltip|Submission Type|Hover tooltip on badge|Explains the reason for the suggestion. E.g. 'Active ELL policy (POL-00421) expiring 08/01/2026 — suggesting Renewal.' Remains visible even after manual override (showing original suggestion).|—|
|Expiring Policy Card|Below Submission Type (Renewal only)|Read-only info card|Shown when Renewal is detected. Displays: Expiring Policy ID (linked), Products, Effective Date, Expiry Date. Auto-populates the 'Expiring Policy ID' field on the submission record.|—|
|Expiring Policy ID|Submission record (hidden from creation form; written on save)|Read-only system field|Auto-populated when submission type is Renewal and an expiring policy is matched in PCAS. Used by downstream renewal workflows.|Auto-populated; not user-editable|
|Mixed-Product Banner|Products Section|Inline alert|Shown when selected products span both renewal-matching and non-matching products. Text: '[Products A, B] match an existing policy (Renewal). [Product C] has no active policy for this account. Consider a separate Cross-Sell submission for [Product C].'|—|
|Override Audit Note|Audit trail (not visible on form)|System log|When a user overrides the auto-detected type, the original system suggestion, the override value, timestamp, and user ID are stored in the submission audit trail.|—|

 

*Key Rules*

 

* Auto-detection runs on account selection and re-runs whenever the Products field is changed

* The Submission Type field always remains user-editable — the auto-detected value is a suggestion, not a lock

* Renewal detection requires an exact product code match between selected products and an active PCAS policy expiring within the configured renewal window (default: 90–180 days)

* Cross-Sell detection requires at least one active policy on the account for any product (i.e., the account is an existing member)

* When a Renewal is detected, the matching expiring policy ID is auto-linked on the submission record as a read-only field (used by legal notice, renewal workflow, and policy comparison features)

* User override of the auto-detected type is always permitted but is logged in the audit trail with the original system suggestion, the override, the timestamp, and the user ID

* The renewal window (90–180 days) is a configurable system parameter; changes are effective immediately without a code release

* If PCAS is unavailable, the field is left blank with a manual verification banner — the system must not block submission creation when the lookup service is down

* Renewal submissions created via this flow must still follow all existing rules from UWB-1 where applicable (e.g., mandatory fields, date validation)

 

*Acceptance Criteria*

 

# On account selection, system queries PCAS for active and expiring policies and the submission DB for prior history, and auto-populates the Submission Type field with the detected type

# An 'Auto-detected' badge is displayed next to the Submission Type field when the system has populated the value

# Hovering over the badge shows a tooltip explaining the reason for the suggestion (policy ID, products, expiry date)

# When Renewal is detected, an Expiring Policy card is shown with the policy number, products, effective date, and expiry date

# When Cross-Sell is detected, system confirms at least one active policy exists for the account on a different product

# When no prior policy is found, type defaults to New Business and a banner confirms this with a manual verification note

# User can override the auto-detected type at any time; the badge updates to 'Manually set' and the original suggestion is retained in the tooltip

# When selected products span both renewal-matching and new products (mixed scenario), an inline banner prompts the user to consider a separate Cross-Sell submission for the new products

# The Expiring Policy ID is written as a read-only system field on the submission record when type is Renewal

10.  All auto-detection outcomes and user overrides (with original suggestion and override value) are written to the submission audit trail

11.  Auto-detection re-runs when the Products field is changed and updates the suggestion accordingly

12.  If PCAS lookup fails, the Submission Type field is left blank with a manual verification banner; submission creation is not blocked

 

*Dependencies:*

PCAS API (active and expiring policy lookup by account and product); Submission database (prior submission history); Salesforce (account record); configurable renewal window parameter in system settings

*Navigation*: 

_Homepage / Submissions / New Submission → on Account Selection (re-runs on Product change)_

*Story* 

|*As an*|Underwriter or BD User|
|*I want to*|have the system automatically suggest the correct submission type (New Business, Cross-Sell, or Renewal) when I select an account — and re-evaluate if I change the selected products|
|*So that*|I spend less time on manual classification, reduce miscategorization errors, and ensure downstream workflows (legal notice eligibility, renewal automation, cross-sell flags) trigger correctly from the start|

*Context / Gap Note*

 In UWB-1 (NB-01: Create New Submission for New Business and Cross Sell), the Submission Type field is a mandatory radio button (New Business / Cross-sell) that the user selects manually. Renewal is not covered in UWB-1. No system logic currently exists to auto-determine or suggest the correct type. This story adds that detection layer on top of the existing field — the field remains user-editable at all times.

*Detection Logic*

 

|Member Status|Current Year Submissions|Policy Number|Product Match|Decision|
|Prospect / Prior Member|Any|Any|Any|New Business|
|Member|1 Renewal|Same for all products|Same as expiring|Renewal|
|Member|2 Renewals|Different per product|Same as expiring|Companion Policy|
|Member|2 Renewals|Same for both|One matches expiring, one new|Cross-Sell|

 *Key Rules:*

||#||Rule||
|1|If Member Status is *Prospect* or *Prior Member* → Always *New Business* (regardless of submissions, policy numbers, or products)|
|2|If Member Status is *Member* AND there is *exactly 1 Renewal Submission* with the *same policy number for all products* AND all products match the expiring policy → *Renewal*|
|3|If Member Status is *Member* AND there are *2 Renewal Submissions* with *different policy numbers* (one per product) AND all products match the expiring policy → *Companion Policy*|
|4|If Member Status is *Member* AND there are *2 Renewal Submissions* with the *same policy number* for both AND one product matches expiring policy, the other is new → *Cross-Sell*|
|5|Any submission type not matching Rules 1–4 → Not defined (error / manual review required)|

h2. Acceptance Criteria

h3. AC1 – New Business

||ID||Criterion||
|AC1.1|When Member Status = *Prospect* → Submission Type defaults to *New Business*|
|AC1.2|When Member Status = *Prior Member* → Submission Type defaults to *New Business*|
|AC1.3|Current Year Submissions, Policy Number, and Product Match do *not* change the decision for Prospect or Prior Member|

h3. AC2 – Renewal

||ID||Criterion||
|AC2.1|When Member Status = *Member* AND there is *only 1 Renewal Submission* for the current year → System checks that the same policy number applies to *all products* in the submission|
